title: Star Cluster Provisional TL1-TL9 Technology / Component Table
purpose: Translate the accepted CP106 family stories and foundation audit into an explicit first-pass player TL1-TL9 technology/component map without changing accepted numerical balance or runtime behavior.

contracts.supportComponentKissRule: An optional support/AUX component belongs only when it materially changes what the player can do, what risk they face, or how efficiently they perform an existing gameplay activity.

statusDefinitions.base: Mature starting-world technology or a later derivative/revival of that baseline family. Base does not mean obsolete or primitive.
statusDefinitions.existing: Already expected or established by the current Star Cluster Concept/accepted architecture. Story placement may still be refined before numerical table work.
statusDefinitions.candidate: A strong proposed addition with a coherent scientific/engineering premise and gameplay role. Candidate is not yet an adopted component or numerical TL-table entry.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Worth preserving, but the owning family, era, prerequisites, gameplay role, or implementation cost is not settled enough for promotion.
statusDefinitions.exotic: Precursor-grade, rule-bending, deliberately extreme weird science, or technology otherwise outside the normal player-developed TL1-TL9 ladder.

structuralRoleDefinitions.core_family: Primary lineage normally represented by a standard/base component family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.maturation: Improves integration, efficiency, reliability, packaging, resilience, or a bounded operating property without changing the core principle.
structuralRoleDefinitions.branch: A specialist or alternate lineage that coexists with the main family rather than automatically replacing it.
structuralRoleDefinitions.cross_pollinated_derivative: An owning-tree technology unlocked or transformed by a genuinely enabling external research discipline.
structuralRoleDefinitions.legacy_revival: A mature older family becomes strategically interesting again because later science enables a new niche or performance envelope.
structuralRoleDefinitions.operating_capability: A mode or capability applied to an existing family rather than a new hardware family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.specialist_auxiliary: A support installation that creates a meaningful design choice without becoming a new visible research tree.
structuralRoleDefinitions.one_off: A useful technology that may have no natural multi-TL progression and does not need a successor merely to fill a cell.
structuralRoleDefinitions.infrastructure: A strategic/site technology rather than an ordinary player-cruiser component.
structuralRoleDefinitions.campaign_technology: A technology whose principal value is exploration, logistics, salvage, diplomacy, or campaign consequence rather than direct combat.
structuralRoleDefinitions.weird_science: A speculative but potentially normal-player scientific concept that can exist as a one-off or rare branch without becoming Precursor magic.
structuralRoleDefinitions.precursor_artifact: Non-player-developed Precursor technology or artifact behavior; TL10 is shorthand only.

optionalComponents.name: Ablative Armor Layer
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Optional expendable outer armor layer; normally replaced rather than repaired in combat.
optionalComponents.notes: Explicit CP107 decision: costs 1 universal Installation Space; not preinstalled.

optionalComponents.name: Kinetic Point-Defense Battery
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Finite-reaction kinetic interception with ammunition.
optionalComponents.notes: Sibling PDS lineage; current 2-Space footprint retained from existing catalog.

optionalComponents.name: Energy / Beam Point-Defense Array
optionalComponents.space: current profile / no new CP107 value
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Power-intensive ammunition-free beam interception.
optionalComponents.notes: CP106 established TL1 baseline; obsolete CP43 TL2 floor is superseded.

optionalComponents.name: Local AMM Point-Defense Battery
optionalComponents.space: current profile / no new CP107 value
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Finite-ammunition guided terminal interception.
optionalComponents.notes: Distinct from later extended-range AMM.

optionalComponents.name: Auxiliary Power Unit
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Preserves core-power continuity only; not normal Tactical Power generation.
optionalComponents.notes: Exact footprint remains later component design.

optionalComponents.name: Auxiliary Reactor
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Small renewable Tactical Power source with bounded output/damage behavior.
optionalComponents.notes: Active Concept supports TL1; obsolete CP43 TL2 floor is superseded.

optionalComponents.name: Combat Battery
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Finite flexible Tactical Power injection for a later legal window.
optionalComponents.notes: Storage remains distinct from sustained generation.

optionalComponents.name: Shield Battery
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Finite shield-specific support that does not become general Tactical Power.
optionalComponents.notes: Exact capacity/charge TBD.

optionalComponents.name: Medical Bay
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Mitigates explicit crew casualty and recovery outcomes.
optionalComponents.notes: No individual-health or treatment micromanagement.

optionalComponents.name: Fuel Processor
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Converts eligible mined or traded Resources into the single Fuel resource at bounded time/efficiency cost.
optionalComponents.notes: Yields and campaign economy bridge remain future work.

optionalComponents.name: Expedition Endurance Module
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Adds bounded Fuel/endurance support without tank-by-tank propellant bookkeeping.
optionalComponents.notes: Current Fuel baseline remains 100; exact bonus TBD.

optionalComponents.name: Scientific Laboratory
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Improves analysis of anomalies, samples, ruins, artifacts, and Research Data.
optionalComponents.notes: Must change outcomes or efficiency rather than exist as flavor.

optionalComponents.name: Mining and Extraction Module
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Enables or improves extraction at eligible sites, trading time/exposure for yield.
optionalComponents.notes: Site/yield rules TBD.

optionalComponents.name: Cargo Expansion
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Adds finite cargo capacity while competing directly with combat/support installations.
optionalComponents.notes: No detailed loading puzzle.

optionalComponents.name: Kinetic Magazine Expansion
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Extends Kinetic ammunition endurance using broad magazine families.
optionalComponents.notes: No individual feed-path bookkeeping.

optionalComponents.name: Missile Magazine Expansion
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Extends missile reserve; Ready Packages remain distinct.
optionalComponents.notes: Exact store TBD.

optionalComponents.name: Boarding / Planetary Mission Package
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Swappable support package improving one mission class.
optionalComponents.notes: Avoid individual gear-loadout bookkeeping.

optionalComponents.name: Supercapacitor Pulse Bank
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Burst-power storage for a bounded operation/window; does not raise sustained reactor output.
optionalComponents.notes: Charge/discharge timing must prevent free loops.

optionalComponents.name: Shield Booster
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Optional powered shield support distinct from the primary generator.
optionalComponents.notes: Exact effect remains later component design.

optionalComponents.name: Power Stabilizer / Conditioner
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Improves bounded power-quality/integration cases rather than adding free output.
optionalComponents.notes: Only implement if explicit compatibility/strain decisions justify it.

optionalComponents.name: General Fabrication Module
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Converts carried Resources into bounded repair or mission supplies over time.
optionalComponents.notes: No free tactical replenishment.

optionalComponents.name: Communications Relay / Mission Communications Suite
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Improves contact, beacon, relay, or strategic communication options while preserving observability/provenance.
optionalComponents.notes: Starting-legal candidate placement follows the IDEA window; exact effect remains TBD.

optionalComponents.name: Shield Hardener
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Existing TL3 optional powered hardening candidate.
optionalComponents.notes: Current 1-Space footprint retained; CP107 does not change its numerical profile.

optionalComponents.name: Hangar / Mission Bay
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: May add small-craft capacity, support heavier craft, or improve turnaround/safety.
optionalComponents.notes: Starting ship has one shuttle. Exact unlock TL and extra-shuttle effect are deliberately not committed in CP107.

optionalComponents.name: Damage-Control Drone Bay
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Robotic inspection/repair support using existing repair capacity, supplies, and condition rules.
optionalComponents.notes: Does not create a second repair engine.

optionalComponents.name: Particle / Radiation Hardening Package
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Specialized protection against explicit particle/radiation effects if those effects exist.
optionalComponents.notes: Not a universal radiation subsystem.

optionalComponents.name: Tractor / Tow Projector
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Bounded manipulation/towing utility for ships, wreckage, cargo, or mission objects.
optionalComponents.notes: Must not become unrestricted combat movement denial.

optionalComponents.name: Superconducting Magnetic Energy Store
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Advanced low-loss storage/conditioning branch.
optionalComponents.notes: Distinct from reactor output.

optionalComponents.name: Thermal Suppression Module
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Finite low-signature/high-output window using thermal storage/retraction abstractions.
optionalComponents.notes: No universal heat meter.

optionalComponents.name: Powered Reactive Armor System
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Powered specialist protection layered onto passive armor; loses active bonus when unpowered.
optionalComponents.notes: Passive armor remains intact.

optionalComponents.name: Molecular Repair Fabricator
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Advanced fabrication improves field repair using Resources without free resurrection.
optionalComponents.notes: Later maturation of the Fabricator/repair lineage.

optionalComponents.name: Electromagnetic Particle Screen
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Powered defense against charged-particle/plasma/radiation threats.
optionalComponents.notes: Specialist counter, not universal armor.

optionalComponents.name: Programmable Matter Repair Patch System
optionalComponents.mechanicalIdentity: Configurable matter patches accelerate bounded structural/component repair.
optionalComponents.notes: Does not resurrect destroyed systems for free.
